meta.name: pestel-delta-monitor
meta.description: Quarterly re-scan of a prior PESTEL analysis. Use when checking which macro factors moved, which assumptions broke, and what's new — turning PESTEL from a workshop artifact into a radar.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定期扫描宏观环境变化，更新PESTEL分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果定期需要追踪宏观因素变化并更新战略假设。
copy.tagline_en: Rescan macro environment changes and update PESTEL analysis quarterly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track macro factor shifts and update strategic assumptions regularly.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把新提供的宏观信息与之前的 PESTEL 分析逐项对比，只报告有实质变动的因素。它会找出被证据推翻的旧假设，标记不再重要的旧条目，并生成一份带引用和置信度的 delta 报告。
howto.when: 当用户提供之前做过的 PESTEL 分析，并询问哪些宏观因素变了、哪些假设被打破，或提到新法规/事件要求重扫时触发。必须先有基线，否则会建议先做完整分析。

say.text: 这是上季度的PESTEL，最近有什么变化？
say.note: Claude 会逐项对比并产出 delta 报告。

say.text: 我们的行业刚通过一项新法规，对照基线重新扫描。
say.note: 它会检查该法规对哪些因素有实质影响。

say.text: 看看基线里哪些假设被打破了？
say.note: 它会标出被证据否定的旧假设。

howto.what_en: Claude diffs new macro info against a prior PESTEL, reports only material per-factor changes, surfaces broken assumptions, flags stale entries, and outputs a cited delta report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a prior PESTEL is supplied and the user asks about moved factors, broken assumptions, or new events. No baseline? It recommends a fresh analysis and stops.

say_en.text: Here's last quarter's PESTEL — what's changed since?
say_en.note: Claude will diff and produce a delta report.

say_en.text: A new regulation just passed; rescan against our baseline.
say_en.note: It checks the regulation's material impact.
